[$openspec-propose](/Users/joyo/Sheaf/.codex/skills/openspec-propose/SKILL.md) lets make a new module and a new synth app (launchable from sheaf patch), standalone not required.  The module is called Dresden 4.  That is a synthesizer trope: astronomical vibes + number of oscilators.  

The app has a single slot with 16 encoders.  

So we have a wavetable vco processor, right?  Dresden 4 has four such.  Its input includes the tuning (cycles per sec), the PM index, the phase offset, the tune multiplier, the wavetable shape and a linear bipolar gain (ring mod) for each oscillator.  Phase offset * index is the phase offset sent to the underlying vco processors, tune freq * the multiplier becomes the frequency of the underlying processor.  The process func appropriately forwards the args to the underlying vcos and processes them, multiply output by linear gain and record the outputs.

There are actually 3 param groups in this synth and associated with this module.  Can a bank/module have multiple param groups?  Check that during spec-ing.  

So params for the desden4vcos module: 

Param group number 1: monophonic.  The module has 16 params, param 8-16 (exclusive zero indexes always) are monophonic.  8-12 are PM index for each vco, which are zero based unipolar exponential params with the center set to 1/4.  12-16 are the frequencies.  Vco 1 goes from 10hz to 160hz, vco2 from 50hz to 800hz, vco3 from 250hz to 2khz, and vco4 from 1khz to 16khz.  

Params 4,5,6,7 are quadrophonic, 4 is called tune as is the frequency multiplier, exponential from 0.5 to 2.  5 is phase, which is linear bipolar from -1 to 1, or equivalently -2pi to 2pi, whatever the appropriate units actually are, it does a full rev forward and back.  6 is waveshape basic linesr 0-1 and 7 is bipolar linear gain -1 to 1.  Any of these params are audio rate modulatable, so phase mod and ring mod are available with 

The module has a final stereo outputz. Params 0 and 1 are two-voice, where one voice is left speaker and the other is right speaker.  Params 0 and 1 are basically x,y xfade between the two params, where voice 0 is the left out and voice 1 is the right out.  Params 2 and 3 are blank for now.  That all will be the first bank.  All params red.  

Next module is reusable bipolar matrix mixer, templatized on size.  Each param is a bipolar zero based exp param setting a gain, same scaling center is 1/4.  Default values identity matrix.  

Create such a 4x4 matrix mixer in this app and wire the inputs to the raw (post linear gain) outputs of the vco and the outputs become modulator 1 for the quad param group.  For now leave all the other modulators empty, this is enough to test the basics.  

Tldr: we have 4 vcos with some params, they get mixed through the matrix and become a modulator, the left and right output are computed from fading the vcos as described above.  

The desden4vco has 4 scopewriters for the raw vcos, and appropriate ui state.  There should be a visualizer which shows the waveforms in a 2x2 grid.  

The main app’s screen should be the 2x2 waveform, the 4x4 encoders representing the unique slot.  

Spec this out and call out any place where the sheaf lib might clash or have missing features needed to build this cleanly.
